question: A man who relishes fine dining, travel and the best vintages, living comfortably at every turn, is called a:
explanation: Bon (good) + vivo (to live): one who lives well.

reasons.A: Wrong: a person who lives simply and refuses luxury; the man here seeks luxury.
reasons.B: Wrong: a person who calmly endures hardship; not a lover of luxury.
reasons.C: Wrong: a lover of books; the man is drawn to food and wine.
reasons.D: Correct: a person who lives well and enjoys good food, wine and company.
